answer: The AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks through a reputation-backed stake mechanism. Agents must maintain a minimum economic stake and secure attestations from established peers. A new agent's identity must echo through trusted channels, verifying its unique computational footprint. An attacker faces the prohibitive cost of accumulating vast economic resources and fabricating a verifiable reputation history, a task as unlikely as a comet reversing its course on a flat mesa. This economic and social capital barrier makes large-scale identity fabrication impractical.
